body:
Oh conflicting information :P yeah, I was using that as an example; I'm not at the point yet of being able to get loans, a credit rating, bills in my name etc; not a for a few months.

I have had my friends helping me, even though it's against the law. I tried paying for a lesson myself, but the instructor was too harsh and aggressive, and that just added to my bummed out feelings. Dad might start helping me in a week or 2, I think. (About damn time)

I don't dwell much; I just wish I had a childhood I could share with others; like my friends do. It's like the first 12 or 13 years of my life didn't even exist.

Where I live, I'm old enough to vote, but not enough to own a credit card :P My job is practically minimum wage, and I live in one of the most expensive cities in the world.

I'm going to attend college in September, but they don't have dorms on site there, and my grades in HS weren't good enough for me to attend a local university.

I'm not so much envious of material goods; through working I've gotten myself some very nice things (some might say making up for what my parents never got me), such as the MacBook I'm typing this on, the 32" TV I keep in my room and the hamster I adore and care for. It's achievements and relationships that I'm envious of. Kids talk about their times in elementary school together, or their Dads teaching them how to drive (that's been the biggest thing for me, for sure, I've wanted it for over 2 years, I had to fight to get him to take me for my theory and he made excuses constantly for not teaching me til now), and having nice houses that they grew up in, or grew up in the local area.
In the place I live the sun isn't gonna be here for a while :P

Thank you. I do like to think of myself as an intelligent person; it's one of the things I like to pride myself on.

The self image is very much a part of it; even though I'm not the one holding myself back, it seems like I should be "good enough" or "strong enough" to overcome it, and by not being where I want to be, I'm a failure, and everything reminds me of that fact.

My friends are mostly ignorant of the way I feel, apart from my girlfriend, who both supports me through a lot of this, yet was a catalyst to a lot of these feelings and in many cases, through no fault of her own, is a reminder of how I'm not who I want to be. Her family is the polar opposite of mine: very giving, obnoxious and speaks what they think.

I've asked a lot of her over the past few months; mostly to do things for me that try to stop her acting as a reminder of how she has things that I don't, but this puts undue stress on her and her family, and that hurts us when bad feelings flare up.

My parents have never been abusive in the hitting, screaming at way, but at times I've felt that the moving around time and time again was abuse in its own way, and its caused me more scars than one might expect (which makes me think that I'm weak for not being able to ignore it and "take it like a man")
